title: Daniel worked under King Nebuchadnezzar.
paragraphs:
Daniel worked under King Nebuchadnezzar.
He learned their language.
He served in government.
He carried excellence.

He worked in Babylon.
He didn’t become Babylon.
“But Daniel resolved not to defile himself…” — Daniel 1:8

Government position ≠ spiritual surrender.
Cultural understanding ≠ cultural absorption.

The real tension isn’t visibility.
It’s loyalty.

Can you stay biblical
and still be culturally relevant?
Or does relevance always demand surrender?
